title.target: I didn't go. Did you go?

objective: Al terminar niegas y preguntas en pasado con didn't y Did…? y das respuestas cortas.

warmup.prompt_es: '¿Fuiste?' 'No fui.' En inglés el trabajo de marcar el pasado lo hace un solo auxiliar: did.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Did you go out last night?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Yes, I did. I went to the cinema.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Did you see a good film?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: No, I didn't. It wasn't very good.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: What a pity! Did your friends come with you?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: No, they didn't. They stayed at home.

glossary.example: Did you go out last night?
Did your friends come with you?
Did you see a good film?

explanation.md_es:
**Negativa:** sujeto + **didn't** (did not) + **verbo base** → *I didn't go. She didn't like it.*

**Pregunta:** **Did** + sujeto + **verbo base** → *Did you see Tom? Did they stay at home?*

**Respuestas cortas:** *Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.*

La clave: el pasado ya lo marca **did**, así que el verbo principal vuelve a su forma base: *didn't go* (no *didn't went*), *Did you go?* (no *Did you went?*).

**Con to be** no se usa did: *I wasn't ill. Were you at home?*

Pronunciación: *didn't* /ˈdɪdnt/.

common_mistakes_es.note: Con didn't el verbo va en base.

common_mistakes_es.right: Did you go to the party?
common_mistakes_es.note: En una pregunta formal se necesita did.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Negativa en pasado: didn't + verbo base.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Negativa en pasado: didn't + verbo base.
